purpose: Enrichment of the existing Haven, Ritual, Counter and Momentum themes

assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original photographic panel for an editorial hospitality identity website. Primary request: a warmly art-directed photograph of a boutique Mediterranean guesthouse, ochre-red arched doorway, cream plaster walls, a richly textured terracotta chair with white linen, olive branch shadows in afternoon sun. Tactile, sophisticated architectural editorial photography, warm ivory and burnt red palette. Portrait 4:5, bold close composition also suitable for a wide crop. Real materials, memorable welcoming atmosphere. No people, no logos, no letters, no UI, no watermark, no abstract geometric illustration.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original photographic panel for a calm contemporary wellbeing identity website. Primary request: a richly detailed close-up photograph of luminous green fern fronds, a few delicate small white blossoms and soft moss beside a natural spring, sunlight through leaves, fresh subtle water droplets. Botanical editorial art direction, sage greens, pale cream highlights and deep emerald shadows; organic and alive, no generic spa products. Portrait 4:5 with a bold diagonal leafy composition that can also crop horizontally. High quality natural photography. No text, no logo, no lettering, no UI, no watermark.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original photographic panel for an artisan retail identity website. Primary request: an intimate editorial photograph of an adult ceramic artisan's hands carefully forming a terracotta bowl on a potter's wheel in a sunlit craft atelier. Clay dust, tactile unglazed ceramics, pale apricot workbench, a small red-orange glazed cup nearby. Crop at torso, hands and objects the main subjects, no face. Warm contemporary craft magazine photography, beautiful honest materials and natural believable hands. Portrait 4:5, readable at small sizes and suitable for a wide crop. No logos, no writing, no letters, no UI, no watermark.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original photographic campaign panel for a bold sports identity website. Primary request: a dynamic low-angle close photograph of an adult runner mid-stride on a vivid cobalt blue running track, electric orange trainers and white socks, legs in motion, cropped at the waist. A crisp sunlight shadow crosses the track, bold powerful diagonal framing, premium sports advertising photography with real surface texture. Portrait 4:5, saturated cobalt and orange, bright daylight, sense of momentum. Anatomically natural adult legs, believable shoes, no logos, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark.
